{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check the number of unique patients
df_dedup_n_unique = df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check the distribution of severity
df_dedup_severity = df_dedup['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Extract fraction of SEVERE patients
fraction_severe = df_dedup_severity.get('severe', 0)

# Report
fraction_severe, df_dedup_n_unique"}
